coach.notice.title: Ua ntej koj qhib AI tus kws qhia
coach.notice.text: Thaum AI tus kws qhia qhib, cov lus hauv txhua lo lus teb uas koj ntaus lossis hais hauv ntu no raug xa ua ntawv mus rau Anthropic, ib lub tuam txhab AI, hla Language Lab lub server, kom sau tau lus tawm tswv yim. Language Lab thiab Anthropic yeej tsis tau txais koj lub suab, tsuas yog cov lus xwb. Teb ua tus neeg tsis muaj tiag. Tsis txhob hais lub npe tiag, chaw nyob, hnub yug, A-number lossis cov ntsiab lus ntawm rooj plaub. Hauv koj qhov kev xam phaj tiag, koj yuav tsum teb qhov tseeb txog koj tus kheej lub neej. Language Lab kuaj qee tus lej, tab sis nws ntes tsis tau txhua yam ntaub ntawv tus kheej. Language Lab tsis khaws koj cov lus teb. Anthropic txoj cai ceev ntiag tug qhia tias Anthropic siv lawv li cas: anthropic.com/legal/privacy. AI tus kws qhia rov kaw thaum koj pib ib qho kev xyaum tshiab.

Thaum qhib, cov ntawv ntawm txhua lo lus teb N-400 raug xa mus rau Anthropic hla Language Lab lub server kom sau tau lus tawm tswv yim; tsis xa suab. Txhawm rau txwv kev siv, lub server suav cov kev thov nrog ib tug lej zais uas hloov txhua hnub, ua los ntawm koj qhov chaw nyob hauv internet; cov lej suav qub raug muab tshem tawm thaum muaj kev thov tom qab, feem ntau hauv ob hnub. Ntu kev kawm txog pej xeem yuav nug {asked} ntawm {bank} lo lus nug uas muaj lub hnub qub (*) hauv daim ntawv teev npe. Hauv kev xyaum no, nws nug tag nrho {asked} lo. Qhab nia dhau ntawm kev xyaum yog {pass} lo lus teb raug. Rau koj tus kheej rooj plaub, saib uscis.gov: hnub nyoog thiab cov xyoo suav rau hnub uas xa daim ntawv thov.
special.englishExempt: USCIS: rau hnub uas xa daim ntawv thov, yog koj muaj 50 xyoo los yog laus dua thiab tau ua neeg nyob mus ib txhis 20 xyoo (50/20), los yog 55 xyoo los yog laus dua thiab 15 xyoo (55/15), koj tsis tas ua raws li qhov yuav tsum paub lus Askiv (nyeem, sau, hais thiab to taub lus Askiv), tab sis koj tseem yuav tsum xeem kev kawm txog pej xeem. Koj xeem tau ua koj hom lus yog koj coj ib tus neeg txhais lus tuaj. Yog koj muaj 65 xyoo los yog laus dua thiab tsawg kawg 20 xyoo (65/20), koj kuj tsis tas xeem lus Askiv, thiab tus tub ceev xwm siv cov ntawv xeem txog pej xeem uas tau xaiv tshwj xeeb.
